findings.note: ESPN shows Carlile, now a Penguins defenseman, with 13 shots in 9 games (about 1.4 per game) at 19:05 TOI. His last five listed games went 1, 1, 2, 0, 1 shots, so only one of five cleared 1.5. This page did not confirm he is in tonight's lineup.

An Oct 4 Rotowire note says Carlile was on Pittsburgh's top pair with Erik Karlsson and had 3 shots in a preseason game. That much ice time is a risk for the Under, although the same page says Pittsburgh did not sign him for his offense.

Pittsburgh signed Carlile on July 1, 2026 after a 2025-26 season split between Tampa Bay and the AHL, where he had a limited, mostly defensive NHL role (42 games, 3 points). He has very little NHL track record for setting a shots line.
